gates.name: Runtime
gates.evidence: persistent state, restart recovery, idempotency and concurrency tests

gates.name: Truth
gates.evidence: source/evidence validation, uncertainty labels and unsupported-claim blocking

gates.name: Security
gates.evidence: credential isolation, prompt-injection, data-boundary and secret-leak tests

gates.name: Audit
gates.evidence: tamper-evident chain, verification and retention evidence

gates.name: Recovery
gates.evidence: timeout, partial execution, ambiguous state, restart and rollback/reconciliation tests

gates.name: Connectors
gates.evidence: real provider integration tests with approval and idempotency controls

gates.name: Operations
gates.evidence: health checks, monitoring, alerts, rate limits and incident procedure

gates.name: Outcome
gates.evidence: expected-vs-actual outcome records with source evidence

gates.name: Regression
gates.evidence: all discovered defects converted to repeatable tests

gates.name: Human approval
gates.evidence: explicit production promotion authorization where required

promotion_rule: Production-ready only when all applicable gates are PASS and no critical gate is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
certificate_rule: A completion certificate may be issued only from an immutable evidence bundle that identifies scope, version, environment, tests, results, unresolved UNKNOWNs, approvals and date.
